# Oshen Sathsara Hettiwana

> Full-Stack Software Engineer, Digital Marketing Specialist, and Director based in Sri Lanka.

## About
Oshen Sathsara Hettiwana is a multifaceted professional operating at the intersection of software engineering and digital branding.
- **Education:** 3rd-year Software Engineering undergraduate (BSc Hons) at Birmingham City University. Professional Higher Diploma in Software Engineering from the Java Institute for Advanced Technology.
- **Current Roles:** IT & Digital Marketing Assistant at the Kegalle Vocational Training Campus (KVTC) and Director at Win Win Solutions.
- **Expertise:** PHP, Laravel, Java, MySQL, UI/UX Design, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator), and Social Media Marketing.

## Projects & Branding

- **Kegalu Welanda Sangamaya System:** Web-based membership and cashbook system. Built with PHP, Bootstrap, Vanilla JS, and MySQL.
- **ISCOM Printers Management System:** Full-stack e-commerce and inventory application. Built with Java, Swing, Hibernate, and MySQL.
